Name: chainbreaker's tenacity
Text: Chosen allied unit gains +1 power until end of turn and gains 2 armor.

Name: tactical withdrawal
Text: return up to one allied unit to its owner's hand. draw 1 card.

Name: blindside
Text: chosen opposing unit gets -3 power until the end of your opponent's turn

Name: Reaver's rush
Text: deploy chosen unit card with power 3 or less from your discard pile for free.

Name: devilhorn scouting party
Text: You may deploy a unit card that costs R3 or less from among the top 3 cards of your deck for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, Scratch 1.

Name: steel rain
Text:
discard up to 3 cards. For each card discarded this way, deal 2 damage to chosen asset.
then, if you have no cards left in your hand, draw 2 cards.

Name: Pincer Tactics
Text: deal 1 damage to up to 2 allied units. Deal 2 damage to chosen non-scratch asset.

Name: allshan's battle trance
Text: deploy chosen unit from your discard pile to the main theater. It gains stalwart and +2 power until the end of your turn.

Name: ambush tactics
Text:
choose two: 
kill chosen unit.
return chosen unit to its owner's hand.
chosen unit deals damage equal to its power to chosen unit. 
put chosen unit on top of its owner's deck.

Name: poisoned rations
Text: chosen unit gets -3 max health until end of your turn.
